scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm test -w shared && npm test -w server && npm test -w client
